title: Consent
transcript:
A desk. A form with too many pages, flagged in yellow where he must sign.
PROGRAM: NIDRA. PARTICIPATION: VOLUNTARY.

His pen doesn't shake. He notices that, even then.
Across the desk a woman in a grey cardigan reads every page and never once looks up at him.

WOMAN:
"You understand that what is removed is not returned."

PARTH:
"I understand."

WOMAN:
"Sign here. And here."

She countersigns. Her hand is the one that shakes.
WITNESS: DR. M. VARMA
